# cyCodeBase vendoring notes

This directory contains the minimal headers needed by Nan's native surface
probe weighted-sample-elimination backend.

- Upstream: https://github.com/cemyuksel/cyCodeBase
- Commit: `62da186e0b2f2d3673d1f18386c66caf5798cd9b`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`
- Vendored files: `cyCore.h`, `cyHeap.h`, `cyPointCloud.h`, and
  `cySampleElim.h`

The upstream headers are copied without modification.
